Name: (CP) Blue Chicken... No. Grey Chicken.
Author: Purr0wpet
Description:
[size=4]WHAT IT DO[/size]
Any time you get a "blue" chicken, it'll come out cutely grey. I kept the comb purple, though, because I thought it contrasted well.

[size=4]REQUIREMENTS[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]SMAPI 2.6+[/size]
[*][size=2]Content Patcher[/size]
[/list]
[size=4]HOW TO USE[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Unzip the folder
[*]Place the unzipped folder into the mods folder
[*]What? That's it
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Blue to Grey Chicken
Manifest.Description: Changes Blue Chickens to Grey Chickens
Manifest.Author: Purrowpet
